t: You're on Ossington Street, a quiet one-way street in W2. It runs from Moscow Road at the north end down to Bayswater Road and Notting Hill Gate at the south end. It feels tucked away from the traffic of those main roads. Charles Mackenzie Phipps, born in 1967, is recorded as having lived here. The material for this street is fairly modest, so simply enjoy the calm of it, a small side street between two busier thoroughfares.
